# References Checklist: Renomear Arquivos das Subpastas 01 e 02 em Três Fases

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos das três fases, com foco em completude, clareza, consistência e mensurabilidade do escopo de renomeação e de atualização de referências.
**Created**: 2026-11-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

- [ ] CHK002 Are the three phases' scopes and priorities explicitly separated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]

- [ ] CHK004 Are the six contract suites that must be updated named in the requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the three files in subpasta 02 that contain old references identified? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Is updating the existing legacy redirect distinguished from creating a new redirect? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the historical specs and generated outputs explicitly excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §SC-008]
